basics.name: Ronald E. Straight
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: I bring decades of experience in high-performance backend engineering, from C and Perl to modern Golang and Kubernetes-native Java and Rust microservices.

work.name: Synacor
highlights: Owned the Golang-based Mailbox Locator Service, an integral part of converting the Zimbra email/collaboration system to a multi-tenant Kubernetes-native service on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

Owned a self-service onboarding and management system for Zimbra built in Java with Dropwizard and hosted on Kubernetes, utilizing OAuth, supporting recurring subscription payments, providing site management and reports.

Leveraged Golang and Kubernetes expertise to migrate several hundred million user mailboxes — containing sensitive personal communications — from bare-metal servers to Zimbra on Kubernetes, maintaining data integrity throughout.

work.name: Adblade / Solve Media
highlights: Owned a high-availability RESTful Data Management Platform (DMP) using Java/Netty, supporting sub-millisecond responses at scale.
Developed custom dispatching annotations and supported multiple HTTP methods for consumer targeting resources stored in Redis.
Ported a legacy image conversion REST server from Ruby to Java and migrated a Solaris data center environment to AWS.

work.name: Kanoodle / Pulse360 / Seevast
highlights: Contributed Oracle-specific enhancements upstream to the DBIx::Class open-source ORM framework while developing heavy Perl ad-serving applications.
Performed Oracle DBA duties, including DDL review and Oracle analytic functions.
Owned a 'RoboDeploy' system for multi-threaded deployment to over 100 servers.

work.name: Netsville
highlights: Co-founded Netsville and developed 'Hazel,' one of the first e-commerce checkout systems, written in POSIX C with a templating language (HZML).

projects.name: Logodal
projects.description: Multiplayer whimsical word game running on a kind cluster in my bedroom. In active development.
highlights: Developed a custom wordlist server in Rust to handle building lexicons and their rules for any language.
Configured networking and TLS termination for public access to the local Kubernetes cluster at logodal.com.
Implemented real-time gameplay mechanics using Perl, plus simple intelligent dummy players.
Use in-cluster ollama to generate personalized quips for the AI players

projects.name: Card Shoggoths
projects.description: Multiplayer poker game with a bit of cosmic horror. In active development.
highlights: Implemented the game server in Golang, with a bare bones index.html/css frontend.
Configured networking for public access to the local Kubernetes cluster at poker.fazigu.org.
